soldier: Head orange-yellow, the base of the nasus darker in colour, the nasus reddish brown, antennae nearly the colour of the head, the anterior part of the pronotum pale reddish brown and its posterior part paler than the anterior, legs and abdomen yellow. Head hairs sparse, several long hairs at the tip of the nasus, hairs on the abdomen more numerous. Head pear-shaped, slightly broader, widest behind the middle, the posterior margin slightly deeply concave or nearly straight, nasus tubular, in profile the vertex and the nasus almost forming a straight line, the nasus projecting forwards and apparently not upturned; in most individuals the mandibles lack an apical spine, in some individuals a small pointed tooth is more evident. Antennae with 13 segments, the second shorter than the third, the fourth shortest, about half as long as the third. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior part upturned, about half as wide as the head, the median concavity of the anterior margin distinct.
